statement.excerpt: Absolutely absurd! I hereby offer @elonmusk a million dollar bet against his prediction that Optimus will be better than the best humans in surgery by the end of the decade.
statement.document_title: Elon Musk’s preposterous and possibly harmful claim about robotic surgery

from_speaker: better than the best humans in surgery
by the end of the decade
a million dollar bet against his prediction
our_interpretation: The end of the decade means December 31, 2029, consistent with the surrounding reference to 2029.
Assess the negative prediction conveyed by the bet, not whether the wager was accepted or funded.
The ordinary reading requires Tesla Optimus to perform surgery autonomously with superior clinical competence and outcomes relative to leading human surgeons.
Neither a narrow dexterity demonstration nor regulatory approval alone establishes the claimed superiority.
criteria.support_condition: At the deadline, sufficiently comprehensive evidence shows that Tesla Optimus has not achieved the specified surgical superiority.
criteria.contradiction_condition: By December 31, 2029, credible comparative clinical evidence establishes that Tesla Optimus performs surgery autonomously better than leading human surgeons across a representative range of procedures.
